title: Lab - Deploy a cluster with kubeadm
description: Build a two-node cluster from scratch.
scenario: Build a two-node cluster from scratch. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Prerequisites
tasks.instructions: On both nodes install containerd, kubeadm, kubelet and kubectl at the same version.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Init
tasks.instructions: Initialise the control plane with pod CIDR 10.244.0.0/16 and set up kubeconfig for your user.

tasks.title: Task 3 - CNI and join
tasks.instructions: Install Flannel and join the worker with the printed command.
tasks.solution:
kubectl apply -f kube-flannel.yml
# on node01: kubeadm join ...
